meaning:
σιτομέτριον, -ου, τό
(σιτομετρέω, Gen.47:12, 14 *, = Attic τὸν σῖτον μετρέω),
a measured portion of food: Luk.12:42 (for exx. in π., see Deiss., BS, 158; LAE, 103.1).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
